title: RecipeScene
description: Canonical recipe scene declaration before source rendering/composition.

elements.description: Source-backed elements composed into the scene.

height.description: Height of the final composed scene in cells.

width.description: Width of the final composed scene in cells.

CellWritePolicy.description: Policy for how a cell write updates cell channels.

oneOf.description: Write the cell exactly, including transparent empty cells.
Skip only transparent empty cell writes, preserving destination cell and role.

ClipPolicy.description: Policy for element cells that land outside the final scene bounds.

oneOf.description: Ignore out-of-bounds element cells and preserve the current composed surface.
Ignore out-of-bounds element cells and emit one element-aware warning diagnostic.

Color.description:
RGBA color with alpha channel for compositing.

Unlike framework-specific color types, this includes an alpha channel
to enable proper effect layering and transparency.

ElementId.description: Stable scene element identity used by diagnostics and future recipe references.

ElementPlacement.description: Placement of an element-local surface into scene coordinates.

x.description: Scene x coordinate where element-local x=0 lands.

y.description: Scene y coordinate where element-local y=0 lands.

GradientSpec.description: Canonical gradient value for descriptor inputs.

space.description: Color interpolation space, such as `rgb` or `hct`.

GradientStop.description: One color stop in a canonical gradient value.

position.description: Normalized stop position in the inclusive 0..1 range.

GraphStep.description: Canonical execution topology for a graph.

oneOf.description: Execute one declared graph node.
Execute child steps in order, where each child reads the prior output.
Execute child branches against the same input snapshot, then merge deltas.

children.description: Authored child branches. Child order is deterministic merge order.

mergePolicy.description: Policy used when multiple branches write the same cell channel.

valueMergePolicy.description: Policy used when multiple branches publish the same graph value id.

GraphValueId.description: Stable value identifier published into a canonical graph-local value bus.

GraphValueMergePolicy.description: Policy for resolving graph value outputs produced by parallel branches.

oneOf.description: Merge branch value outputs in authored child order; later outputs win.
Reject the merge when multiple branches publish the same graph value id.

InternedRoleName.description:
Opaque interned name for a `RoleTag::Custom` variant.

A newtype wrapper around `InternedString` so custom role names are
distinct at the type level from other interned identifiers
(`LayerId`, `RecipeId`). Foreign code can read the inner name via
`as_str()` but cannot accidentally substitute a `LayerId` for a role
name or vice versa.

LayerId.description: Optional scene layer identity used for grouping elements without a full layer graph.

LifecyclePhase.description: Named high-level interval in a recipe lifecycle.

oneOf.description: Initial appearance or setup interval.
Sustained interval that may be fixed or trigger-terminated.
Final departure or teardown interval.

NodeId.description: Stable node identifier inside a canonical graph.

NumericRange.description: Optional inclusive numeric bounds for a value spec.

ParallelMergePolicy.description: Policy for resolving channel writes produced by parallel graph branches.

oneOf.description: Merge branches in authored child order; later same-channel writes win.
Reject the merge when multiple branches write the same cell channel.

RecipeElementPipeline.description: Optional element-local pipeline reference into the canonical graph.

graph.description: Graph that owns the nodes used by this element-local pipeline.

topology.description: Optional pipeline topology subset for this element.

RecipeElementPipelineTiming.description:
Element-local timing for scene layer pipeline effects.

These values are relative to the parent recipe timeline. They do not choose
a clock policy; the recipe lifecycle clock still owns sample-space
interpretation. Renderers use this envelope only to derive a local
`phase_t` for element-local pipeline steps.

enterEase.description: Element-local enter easing label preserved for backend/tooling parity.

enterOffsetMs.description: Offset from parent timeline start before the element enter effect begins.

exitEase.description: Element-local exit easing label preserved for backend/tooling parity.

exitOffsetMs.description: Offset from parent exit timeline start before the element exit effect begins.

RecipeSceneElement.description: Scene element whose surface is produced by a declared source instance.

cellWritePolicy.description: Policy for whether transparent empty local cells write or skip.

clipPolicy.description: Policy for local cells that land outside the final scene bounds.

id.description: Stable element identity, distinct from roles and source instances.

motion.description: Optional structured element motion payload preserved from scene authoring.

overflow.description: Optional overflow policy beyond simple scene-bound clipping.

pipeline.description: Optional source-local or element-local pipeline reference.

placement.description: Placement of the source-produced surface in scene coordinates.

placementRule.description: Optional declarative placement rule preserving anchor, sibling-relative, and motion placement semantics.

roleWritePolicy.description: Policy for how a written cell updates the final scene role channel.

source.description: Source instance that produces this element-local semantic surface.

surface.description: Optional layer-local surface style and shadow envelope.

visibility.description: Optional typed visibility policy for phase-aware or binding-backed layer visibility.

zIndex.description: Z order; higher values compose later and appear above lower values.

Rect.description:
Rectangle in cell coordinates.

This is the primary geometry type for defining effect regions.

x.description: Left edge x coordinate in cells.

y.description: Top edge y coordinate in cells.

RoleTag.description:
Per-cell semantic role tag.

Twelve first-class variants cover the common roles. `Custom(name)` covers
ad-hoc recipe-declared roles. `#[non_exhaustive]` preserves room for
future first-class additions without a breaking change.

Every first-class variant has a stable numeric ID in `RoleInterner`
(Background=0, Text=1, …, Procedural=11); Custom IDs start at 12.

oneOf.description: Fill cells (no glyph or styled space).
Primary content text.
Title / header text.
Secondary / sub text.
Structural / decorative borders.
Image / pixel-art / glyph-art cells.
Small icon glyphs.
Status / focus / selection markers.
Emphasized content (search hits, etc.).
Shadow content — source layer OR pipeline output.
Ornamental cells (dividers, ornaments).
Cells produced by a procedural source.
Author-declared custom role, such as `"logo_silhouette"`.

Custom.description: Custom role name serialized as a string.

RoleWritePolicy.description: Policy for how a cell write updates the semantic role channel.

oneOf.description: Preserve the destination role.
Copy the sampled-source role.
Set one explicit role, used by procedural/shadow-style writers.

role.description: Role to write into the destination role channel.

SceneAnchor.description: Named anchor point used to place an element inside a scene or sibling layer.

oneOf.description: Top-left corner.
Top edge centered horizontally.
Top-right corner.
Left edge centered vertically.
Center point.
Right edge centered vertically.
Bottom-left corner.
Bottom edge centered horizontally.
Bottom-right corner.

SceneElementOverflowPolicy.description: Policy for element-local cells that overflow the element's scene placement.

oneOf.description: Clip overflowing cells to the scene bounds.
Hide the entire element when any painted cell would overflow.
Wrap overflowing cells back inside the scene bounds.

SceneElementPlacementRule.description:
Declarative placement rule for a recipe scene element.

The existing `placement` field remains the resolved absolute fallback.
`placementRule` carries richer scene authoring intent so players and validators
can reproduce anchor, sibling-relative, and motion-aware scenes without
flattening those semantics out of the recipe tree.

oneOf.description: Place by an absolute target rectangle in scene coordinates.

motion.description: Optional placement-motion payload preserved from scene authoring.

oneOf.description: Place relative to a scene anchor or an already-declared sibling layer.

motion.description: Optional placement-motion payload preserved from scene authoring.

offsetColumns.description: Column offset applied after resolving the anchor.

offsetRows.description: Row offset applied after resolving the anchor.

siblingLayer.description: Optional sibling layer used as the anchor frame instead of the scene.

SceneElementSurface.description:
Element-local surface styling envelope.

This is the canonical v3.1 home for authored layer base style and attached
shadow details. The payloads are structured because the stable style and
shadow vocabularies are still owned by their descriptor/runtime adapters.

baseStyle.description: Optional base style applied before the element-local pipeline.

shadow.description: Optional attached shadow payload owned by this element surface.

SceneElementVisibility.description: Visibility policy for one recipe scene element.

oneOf.description: Element is always visible.
Element is visible only for the listed lifecycle phases.

phases.description: Lifecycle phases where the element is visible.

oneOf.description: Element visibility is decided by evaluating a typed value source.

predicate.description: Predicate that decides whether the element is visible.

source.description: Source value used by the visibility predicate.

oneOf.description: Match every in-bounds cell.
Match cells with the requested role in the active role space.

role.description: Role required in the active role space.

oneOf.description: Match a rectangle in the active coordinate space.

rect.description: Rectangle to match in the active coordinate space.

oneOf.description: Match rows `[start, end)` in the active coordinate space.

end.description: Exclusive end row in the active coordinate space.

start.description: Inclusive start row in the active coordinate space.

oneOf.description: Match columns `[start, end)` in the active coordinate space.

end.description: Exclusive end column in the active coordinate space.

start.description: Inclusive start column in the active coordinate space.

oneOf.description: Match rows where `row % modulus == remainder`.

modulus.description: Positive modulus used to select rows.

remainder.description: Remainder selected by the modulo expression.

oneOf.description: Match columns where `column % modulus == remainder`.

modulus.description: Positive modulus used to select columns.

remainder.description: Remainder selected by the modulo expression.

oneOf.description: Match cells containing non-empty glyph content.
Match the outer perimeter band.
Match cells that are not on the outer perimeter.

StructuredValue.description:
JSON-compatible structured payload owned by a descriptor field.

Use this only when the primitive owns a nested payload whose stable shape is
descriptor-specific, such as path lists, particle options, or glyph-style
rule tables. Prefer narrower typed values whenever a field has scalar,
color, gradient, duration, scope, or rect semantics.

Value.description: Canonical tagged literal value used by effect input specs.

oneOf.description: Explicit absence of a value.
Boolean true/false literal.
Signed integer literal without a fractional component.
Floating-point numeric literal.
Short machine-facing string literal.
Human-facing text literal.
RGBA color literal.
Gradient stop payload.
Duration literal expressed as seconds.
Closed-set enum literal.
Semantic role literal.
Surface scope literal.
Cell rectangle literal.
Descriptor-owned structured JSON literal.

ValuePredicate.description: Typed predicate evaluated against a lifecycle trigger value source.

Source value must be boolean false.
Source value must be a non-zero integer, number, or duration.
Source value must be a non-empty string or text value.
Source value must equal the typed literal.

value.description: Typed literal used for equality comparison.

oneOf.description: Source value must not equal the typed literal.

value.description: Typed literal used for inequality comparison.

oneOf.description: Source value must be greater than the typed numeric literal.

value.description: Typed numeric literal used as the exclusive lower bound.

oneOf.description: Source value must be less than the typed numeric literal.

value.description: Typed numeric literal used as the exclusive upper bound.

oneOf.description:
Convenience level predicate with documented per-kind truthiness behavior.

The contract truth table is boolean true, integer non-zero, finite number
non-zero, string/text non-empty, color or gradient value present, and finite duration
non-zero. Null, enum, role, scope, and rect have no I0 truth rule.

fallback.description: Optional fallback literal when the signal is unavailable.
